# NINO V2 — artwork production closure (owner-approved 2 Nov 2026)

## Decision
Freeze approved character, chapter icon, stamp, postcard, passport, micro-icon and static pizza masters; **no new essential illustration designs** for the current offline computer release. Do not redesign approved sources or silently alter art, tests, geography, rewards or learning state. This issue is an **asset closeout / evidence gate**, not a merge/deploy authorization.

## Verified source state
- Hermes independent review 29 Oct 2026, commit `9e58e756f124`: 18 new assets checked; 20 existing passport masters untouched; ISOLE/ARRIVO approved; 2 Gold seals artwork approved subject to final export; blank passport resolution caveat.
- PR #66 (31 Oct): original Venezia postcard **variant B scalloped edge visually approved**. Source contour + reproducible export recipe in Git; definitive full/tight transparent PNG/WebP binaries **not** uploaded to Git.
- PR #65: owner-approved micro-v2 icons are in Git as real binaries; no runtime integration claim.
- PR #63: hinged Pisa pizza-box rig **REWORK**, not animation-ready. Static open-box fallback remains valid. Treat animation as separate enhancement, not blocker for current offline computer release.
- PR #61: working integrated offline computer candidate with lead QA; draft, separate independent Codex review, Safari/owner acceptance still open.
- Additional optional story assets (Milan calcio, Bologna pit stop, gelati) are **future scope**, not hidden release blockers.

## Closeout checklist
- [ ] Create inventory ledger with exact paths, SHA-256/blobs, dimensions, alpha/color, owner approval, intended runtime placement; distinguish originals, approved derivatives, missing exports and future concepts.
- [ ] Verify exact Gold small/large asset exports, transparency, small-size readability and WebP/PNG equivalence. Do not mark PASS from visual QA alone.
- [ ] Generate Venezia B full/tight transparent 1536x1024 PNG + lossless WebP using PR #66 recipe and existing original master; retain painting pixel data; verify correct scalloped transparent outline and check image at 100%. Push actual binaries + manifest to art branch; compare against owner-approved rendering and document non-byte-identical alpha edge where relevant.
- [ ] Check all passport masters/blank pages resolution limitations, chapter icon 11/11, ink stamps, postcards, reverse, ISOLE/ARRIVO; confirm all referenced runtime binaries exist rather than merely local ZIPs or preview images.
- [ ] Check micro-v2 #65 integration in offline HTML and favicon without external requests; report as NOT INTEGRATED if still only art-only PR.
- [ ] Confirm static Pisa pizza-box presentation works honestly; keep true hinged lid animation **deferred / separate #31 / PR #63**.
- [ ] Produce before/after real-browser captures for relevant reward/passport displays; run file:// offline/no-network tests and preserve 45 IDs, 11 chapters, saves, 8 slices→pizza / 3 pizzas→trip and exact source geometry.
- [ ] Independent QA of exact delivery SHA by an agent other than exporter/integrator; record deviations and owner visual acceptance.
- [ ] Publish single release ledger classifying **READY / EXPORT PENDING / INTEGRATION PENDING / OPTIONAL DEFERRED**. Do not label entire artwork package DONE until export + QA evidence is attached.

## Execution / responsibilities
**Codex**: focused asset inventory + final exports and bounded integration after approved assets exist. **Hermes**: independent exact-SHA visual/technical QA (do not duplicate build). **Main/owner**: signoff only. If current PR #61 already has a different active QA role allocation, avoid duplicate work and preserve the existing review gate.

**No merge, production deployment, release promotion, replacement of approved learner HTML, or rewrite of source masters without owner signoff.**
Related: #43 #45 #46 #21 #31 #54, PRs #61 #63 #65 #66.
